text:
mia: Heads up — PR evals started overlapping with nightly GH Actions runs since the last infra deploy. Seen stuck runners and artifact races.

sam: Yep, saw duplicate evals for #5123 at 10:03 and 10:04 UTC. Buildkite unaffected. GHA scheduled job seems to fire while PR job still running.

jordan: Likely cron drift + timezone mismatch. .github/workflows/evals.yml uses '0 0 * * *' but team thought it was PST. GHA cron is UTC.

mia: That explains it — nightly shifted into prime PR window. Can we change the schedule or add concurrency/cancel-in-progress to avoid overlap?

sam: Concurrency is a good first step. Also we can short-circuit nightly when a PR is in-flight. Example to add to the workflow:

```
concurrency:
  group: "evals-nightly"
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  nightly:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
```

jordan: Concurrency prevents same workflow overlaps but doesn't stop a PR-triggered eval from overlapping with the schedule. You can use `if: github.event_name == 'schedule'` on the nightly job so it only runs for scheduled events.

anita: Another option is switching to a workflow_run pattern: schedule kicks off a coordinator workflow which then triggers evals. That gives explicit ordering but is heavier. For now adding concurrency + event guard is simplest.

sam: I'd also add a tiny distributed lock at the start of the eval runner to handle cross-platform cases (GHA vs Buildkite). Pseudocode:

```
# exit if lock exists, else create short-lived lock
if aws s3api head-object --bucket ci-locks --key evals.lock; then
  echo "lock present, exiting"
  exit 1
else
  aws s3api put-object --bucket ci-locks --key evals.lock --body "$(date)" --expires-in 60
fi
```

mia: I'll open a PR with these changes (concurrency + if condition + optional s3 lock step). Filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321

ci-bot: deploy-bot: When PR is opened I'll run smoke evals automatically and report back.

anita: :thumbsup: Please add a small integration test that simulates cron overlap (set GHA env vars and run locally via act or use workflow_dispatch test).

jordan: After merge, monitor runner-heartbeat and eval artifact dedupe metrics for 24 hours. If we still see duplication we'll migrate to workflow_run/coordinator model.

sam: PR draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/789 branch gha/eval-cron-fix. Includes unit tests and the lock step as an opt-in step behind env var EVAL_LOCK_ENABLED=true.

mia: Merged and deployed to main. Will monitor the next nightly and update INF-4321.

sam: Observability note — add a metric `ci.eval.overlap_count` to the console dashboard so we can graph before/after.

mia: Good call, adding a dashboard tile now. Thanks everyone.
